hints.title: Monotonic Feasibility
hints.text: If it is possible to give each child m candies, it is also possible to give each child any amount less than m.

hints.title: Feasibility Predicate
hints.text: For a chosen pile size m, pile c yields c // m children piles. Summing c // m across all piles tells if at least k children can be served.

hints.title: Binary Search Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search over candy size takes logarithmic iterations, with linear verification each step.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear search from max(candies) downward takes O(n * max(candies)) which TLEs for values up to 10^7.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes monotonic predicate and writes clean binary search on answer space.
